Game Overview

Il gioco della Scopa is a card game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Il gioco della Scopa is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Il gioco della Scopa?

Il gioco della Scopa is a free card game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Il gioco della Scopa free to play?

Yes, Il gioco della Scopa is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
